QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_62

question.text: A fund reports returns over 5 years: 10%, 12%, 14%, 16%, 18%. Mean return is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Arithmetic mean of percentage changes = (10 + 12 + 14 + 16 + 18) / 5 = 70 / 5 = 14%. The Trap: Option A is the minimum, not the mean. Option B is one of the observations, not the mean. Option D is the sum of returns, not the mean. Note: The workbook treats arithmetic mean of periodic returns as the standard measure of average return for the risk-measurement section.
